question_en: List the figures in section 6.1.3.1 of spec 38.321 (figure lookup).
original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.321'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section {sectionNumber:'6.1.3.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH s, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s)-[:CONTAINS_FIGURE]->(f:TSFigure) RETURN f.figureId, f.figureNumber, f.figureCaption
reference_query:
MATCH (anchor:Section {sectionNumber: '6.1.3.1'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.321'})
MATCH (anchor)-[:CONTAINS_FIGURE]->(item:TSFigure)
RETURN DISTINCT item.figureId AS figureId
